Once it ships, how long is delivery?
Once your order has finished production and leaves the warehouse, standard ground delivery typically takes 1 to 5 business days (or up to 6 business days depending on your location).
For larger or oversized items that ship via freight, delivery is scheduled by appointment once the shipment arrives at your local freight terminal.
